stem: At a routine 12-month review, which fluids are encouraged as the primary intake for a child?
explanation: Water and cow’s milk are encouraged as the primary fluids from 12 months of age.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 12

rationale: This reflects the usual transition from infant feeding to a toddler diet at 12 months, with water and cow’s milk as the main drinks.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because formula and fruit juice are not the recommended primary fluids at 12 months.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because water and cow’s milk are encouraged as the primary intake from 12 months of age.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because electrolyte solution is reserved for specific clinical situations rather than routine intake.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because cow’s milk alone omits water, which should also be part of the primary fluid intake.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because breast milk and fruit juice are not the preferred primary fluid pattern at 12 months.
